response.overlap_recovery_reason: The three decays are visually separable across the main plot aside from the shared start point and a near-axis red tail, so a separate overlap-recovery pass is not warranted.

curves.overlap_notes: The first plotted point is shared with the other two curves at the upper-left start; the remainder is visually distinct.
The blue curve shares the initial start point with the other two series but is otherwise clearly separated.
The red curve shares the initial start point with the other curves and then runs close to the bottom border in the far-right tail.

response.interpretation_notes: Main plot only. Three legend-mapped pH decay curves were traced in cropped-panel pixel coordinates. Marker centers were prioritized, with extra points along connector segments for coverage. The required overlap QA accepted this draft without revision and reported panel_quality = pass.
unresolved_ambiguities: The common upper-left start point is visually shared by all three curves.
The red pH 11 tail becomes very close to the bottom border in the last third of the plot.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
